newsitem.title: USA: Cliffs Drilling stake cut by Appalosa.
newsitem.headline: Cliffs Drilling stake cut by Appalosa.

text.p: A group led by Appalosa Management L.P. on Tuesday said it cut its stake in Cliffs Drilling Co to 529,327 common shares, or 7.1 percent, from 10.13 percent held previously.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 93,608 common sold between December 17 and January 24 at prices ranging from $57 to $78.2474 each.

The Houston, Texas, company is engaged in drilling of oil and gas wells for major and independent oil and gas companies on land, inland waters and offshore. It provides mobile offshore production units.
